result.summary: This is a narrow, one-way residential street featuring sidewalks on both sides and a marked crosswalk. While the low-speed environment is generally pedestrian-friendly, safety is compromised by faded pavement markings and sightline obstructions from street trees and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from vegetation
hazards.description: A large tree at the corner may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of drivers approaching the intersection.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulbout)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.
